5. The method of claim 1, wherein the selecting content that is age appropriate for a particular infant comprises selecting content that comprises:
6. An audio device (10, 110) for use in neonatal care, the audio device (10, 110) comprising:

a smooth ovate shell (12, 112) comprising plastic, the smooth ovate shell (12, 112) defining an outer surface (11, 111) and an inner surface (13, 113), the outer surface (11, 111) forming a curved continuous planar surface, wherein the outer surface (11, 111) of the smooth ovate shell (12, 112) comprises: a deformable region, wherein one or more electrical switches (14A, 16A, 18A, 114A, 118A), in communication with the electronic elements (19, 119), are functionally accessible through at least one of touch and proximity; and the inner surface (13, 113) of the smooth ovate shell (12, 112) housing: the electronic elements (19, 119) comprising:
7. An audio device (10, 110) of claim 6 wherein electronic elements (19, 119) comprise an induction charger to charge the battery (30).

8. An audio device (10, 110) of claim 6 wherein the one or more electrical switches comprise at least one of a proximity sensor and a touch sensor and wherein the audio signal received by input to the electrical circuit is received through a short-range interconnection signal.

9. The audio device (10, 110) of claim 6, the microcomputer (32) configured to maintain a volume of the speaker (38) at a preset level for a preset time and to maintain a volume of the speaker (38) at a preset level based upon an input age of an infant.

10. The audio device (10, 110) of claim 6, wherein the one or more electric switches project from the inner surface (13, 113) to be functionally accessible from the outer surface (11, 111) of the smooth shell (12, 112).

11. The audio device (10, 110) of claim 6, wherein the one or more electrical switches (14A, 16A, 18A, 114A, 118A) extend through one or more switch apertures (14B, 16B, 18B, 114B, 118B) in the smooth ovate shell (12, 112) and are flush with the outer surface (11, 111) of the smooth shell (12, 112).

12. The audio device (10, 110) of claim 6, wherein the one or more electric switches (14A, 16A, 18A, 114A, 118A) project from the inner surface (13, 113) to be flush with the outer surface (11, 111) of the smooth shell.
13. The audio device (10, 110) of claim 6, wherein the one or more electric switches (14A, 16A, 18A, 114A, 118A) comprises one of a power switch, a fast forward switch, and a reverse switch.

14. The audio device (10, 110) of claim 6, further comprising a plurality of spaced apart apertures (14B, 16B, 18B, 114B, 118B) for accessing electronic elements (19, 119) disposed within the smooth ovate shell (12, 112).

15. The audio device (10, 110) of claim 6, further wherein the electrical switches (14A, 16A, 18A, 114A, 118A) have one more switch covers (14, 16, 18) that comprise pliable material molded with the smooth ovate shell (12, 112), wherein the smooth ovate shell 12 and the one or more switch covers 14, 16, 18 form a continuous body.
